acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, repeat the same native-task contract fingerprint probe from CURRENT v21 and vary no factor other than carrier_variance. Do not infer a distinct carrier unless a provider-exposed carrier field changes.

native_task_read.title: HFO X12 Durable Object PDCA Lab

experiment.hypothesis: Across four wakes, the task contract fingerprint and exact task binding should remain stable even if the underlying carrier instance changes. Any provider-exposed carrier field may vary, but opaque fields must remain UNKNOWN rather than inferred.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: A later wake with the same task ID returns a different task-contract or schedule digest without an authorized task mutation; an exposed carrier field changes but is suppressed; a duplicate idempotency key is accepted; a stale version advances; or event/CURRENT readback fails.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This first wake establishes only a same-provider task-contract baseline. The native surface does not expose model build, worker instance, conversation identity, or Project context, so it cannot prove that a different carrier executed the wake. Stable task metadata can mask carrier changes. The event and CURRENT pointer are separate Git commits, and Slack follows both; GitHub's single-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, database isolation, exactly-once execution, or transactional Slack durability.
canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If later invalidated, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA.
